<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent">
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-title" content="BuzzPal">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#7c5cff">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="icon-180.png">
<link rel="icon" href="icon-192.png">
<title>BuzzPal</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Baloo+2:wght@500;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/qrcodejs/1.0.0/qrcode.min.js" defer></script>
<style>
:root{
--bg1:#7c5cff; --bg2:#ff5fa2; --ink:#2a1f4f; --card:#fff; --muted:#7a7396;
--safe-t:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px); --safe-b:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
--safe-l:env(safe-area-inset-left,0px); --safe-r:env(safe-area-inset-right,0px);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;height:100%;font-family:"Baloo 2",ui-rounded,"SF Pro Rounded",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink)}
body{background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg1),var(--bg2));background-attachment:fixed;overflow-x:hidden;
padding:calc(var(--safe-t) + 10px) calc(var(--safe-r) + 14px) calc(var(--safe-b) + 14px) calc(var(--safe-l) + 14px);
-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none}
input,select,textarea{-webkit-user-select:text;user-select:text;font:inherit}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:none}
.hidden{display:none!important}
h1,h2,h3{margin:0;line-height:1.1}
/* ---------- generic UI ---------- */
.panel{background:var(--card);border-radius:24px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(40,10,90,.25);margin-bottom:14px}
.btn{background:var(--bg1);color:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 18px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;box-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:transform .08s}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.btn.ghost{background:#efeaff;color:var(--bg1)}
.btn.danger{background:#ef4444}
.btn.big{font-size:22px;padding:16px 22px;width:100%}
.row{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
label.f{display:block;font-weight:700;margin:10px 0 4px}
.inp{width:100%;padding:12px 14px;border-radius:14px;border:2px solid #e4ddff;font-size:17px;background:#faf8ff;color:var(--ink)}
.inp:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--bg1)}
.muted{color:var(--muted)}
.small{font-size:14px}
.code{font-family:ui-monospace,Menlo,monospace;background:#f2eeff;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:8px;word-break:break-all;-webkit-user-select:all;user-select:all}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(var(--safe-b) + 24px);transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(40px);opacity:0;
background:#2a1f4f;color:#fff;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;z-index:999;transition:.3s;pointer-events:none;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
/* ---------- welcome ---------- */
.center{min-height:calc(100vh - 40px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}
.logo{font-size:64px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15);text-align:center}
.logo small{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;opacity:.9}
/* ---------- kid view ---------- */
#kid{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto}
.kid-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px;gap:10px}
.kid-top h1{font-size:clamp(26px,4vw,40px);font-weight:800;text-shadow:0 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15)}
.status{font-size:15px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:4px 12px;border-radius:999px;white-space:nowrap}
.status .dot{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#facc15;margin-right:6px}
.status.on .dot{background:#4ade80}
.status.off .dot{background:#f87171}
.moods{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow-x:auto;padding:6px 2px 12px;scrollbar-width:none}
.moods::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.mood{flex:0 0 auto;background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;border:3px solid transparent;transition:transform .15s}
.mood .me{font-size:28px}
.mood.sel{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#facc15;transform:scale(1.08);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(min(46%,210px),1fr));gap:16px}
.kbtn{position:relative;border-radius:30px;padding:18px 12px 16px;color:#fff;min-height:170px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
box-shadow:0 9px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22),0 14px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:transform .1s,box-shadow .1s,filter .2s;overflow:hidden}
.kbtn:active{transform:translateY(7px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.kbtn .e{font-size:clamp(56px,8vw,78px);line-height:1;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.15))}
.kbtn .t{font-size:clamp(19px,2.4vw,25px);font-weight:800;margin-top:8px;text-align:center;line-height:1.1;text-shadow:0 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.kbtn.sent{animation:sentPop .6s}
.kbtn[disabled]{filter:saturate(.35) brightness(.9)}
.kbtn::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.28),transparent 45%);pointer-events:none}
@keyframes sentPop{0%{transform:scale(1)}30%{transform:scale(.9)}60%{transform:scale(1.08)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.recharge{height:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:0 0 12px;position:relative}
.recharge i{position:absolute;inset:0;width:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#facc15,#4ade80);border-radius:99px}
.recharge-wrap{color:#fff;font-weight:700;text-align:center}
.kid-foot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:18px;color:#fff}
.gear{font-size:26px;opacity:.55;padding:8px;border-radius:50%;position:relative}
.gear .ring{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;opacity:0;transform:scale(.5)}
.gear.holding .ring{animation:hold 1.6s linear forwards}
@keyframes hold{from{opacity:.2;transform:scale(.5)}to{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.4)}}
.lastreply{background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:700;font-size:16px}
.tip{background:#fff7d6;border-radius:18px;padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:14px;font-size:16px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.tip b{color:#b45309}
/* sent splash on kid */
.flyer{position:fixed;font-size:70px;z-index:50;pointer-events:none;animation:fly 1.1s ease-in forwards}
@keyframes fly{0%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1) rotate(0)}100%{transform:translate(40vw,-110vh) scale(.4) rotate(40deg);opacity:.2}}
/* ---------- overlays ---------- */
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;background:rgba(30,15,70,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px)}
.sheet{background:#fff;border-radius:28px;padding:22px;max-width:420px;width:100%;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.pinpad{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:14px}
.pinpad button{background:#f2eeff;border-radius:18px;font-size:28px;font-weight:800;padding:14px 0}
.pinpad button:active{background:#e0d7ff}
.pindots{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:14px;margin:12px 0}
.pindots i{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--bg1)}
.pindots i.f{background:var(--bg1)}
.shake{animation:shake .45s}
@keyframes shake{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(-12px)}40%{transform:translateX(12px)}60%{transform:translateX(-8px)}80%{transform:translateX(8px)}}
/* reply reveal on kid */
#reveal{flex-direction:column;background:rgba(20,10,50,.6)}
#reveal .card{background:#fff;border-radius:36px;padding:30px 26px;max-width:560px;width:100%;text-align:center;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.4);position:relative;z-index:2}
#reveal .from{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-size:20px}
#reveal .bigE{font-size:clamp(110px,22vw,170px);line-height:1.15;display:inline-block}
#reveal .msg{font-size:clamp(28px,5vw,42px);font-weight:800;line-height:1.1;margin:6px 0 16px}
#reveal .tapsound{font-weight:700;color:var(--bg1);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:10px}
.particle{position:fixed;top:-60px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;animation:fall linear forwards}
@keyframes fall{to{transform:translateY(115vh) rotate(var(--rot,360deg))}}
.confetto{width:12px;height:18px;border-radius:3px}
.a-pop{animation:aPop .7s cubic-bezier(.2,1.8,.4,1)}
@keyframes aPop{0%{transform:scale(0)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.a-shake{animation:aShake .6s 3}
@keyframes aShake{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}25%{transform:rotate(-18deg)}75%{transform:rotate(18deg)}}
.a-wobble{animation:aWob 1.2s ease-in-out 2}
@keyframes aWob{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0) rotate(0)}25%{transform:translateX(-20px) rotate(-10deg)}75%{transform:translateX(20px) rotate(10deg)}}
.a-spin{animation:aSpin 1.4s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.5,1) 2}
@keyframes aSpin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
.a-bounce{animation:aBounce .5s ease-in-out 5 alternate}
@keyframes aBounce{from{transform:translateY(0) scale(1,1)}to{transform:translateY(-40px) scale(.95,1.08)}}
.a-zoom{animation:aZoom 1s cubic-bezier(.2,1.4,.4,1)}
@keyframes aZoom{0%{transform:translateX(-120vw) skewX(-20deg)}70%{transform:translateX(20px) skewX(10deg)}100%{transform:none}}
.a-ring{animation:aRing .12s linear 14}
@keyframes aRing{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}25%{transform:rotate(-14deg)}75%{transform:rotate(14deg)}}
.a-pulse{animation:aPulse .8s ease-in-out 4}
@keyframes aPulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.25)}}
.a-float{animation:aFloat 2s ease-in-out 2}
@keyframes aFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-5deg)}50%{transform:translateY(-25px) rotate(5deg)}}
.rainbow-bg{animation:rainbow 2s linear infinite}
@keyframes rainbow{from{filter:hue-rotate(0)}to{filter:hue-rotate(360deg)}}
/* ---------- parent view ---------- */
#parent{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto}
.p-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;color:#fff;margin-bottom:12px}
.p-top h1{font-size:30px;font-weight:800}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);padding:5px;border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:14px}
.tabs button{flex:1;color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;padding:10px 2px;border-radius:14px;white-space:nowrap}
.tabs button.on{background:#fff;color:var(--bg1)}
.inbox-item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:2px dashed #eee8ff;align-items:flex-start}
.inbox-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.inbox-item .ie{font-size:34px;line-height:1}
.inbox-item .it{font-weight:800;font-size:18px;line-height:1.15}
.inbox-item .im{font-size:16px}
.inbox-item .tm{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
.inbox-item.urgent{background:#fff1f1;border-radius:14px;padding:12px;border-bottom:0;margin:4px 0}
.qr-row{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.qr-row button{background:#f2eeff;border-radius:12px;padding:4px 10px;font-weight:700;font-size:15px}
.rgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.rbtn{border-radius:20px;padding:14px 8px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:17px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:2px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.rbtn:active{transform:translateY(4px);box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.rbtn .e{font-size:38px;line-height:1.1}
.rbtn .fx{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;opacity:.9}
.edit-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:62px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:10px;border-radius:18px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#fff}
.edit-item .inp{background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);border-color:transparent;padding:9px 10px}
.edit-item .emo{text-align:center;font-size:28px;padding:4px}
.edit-item .ctrls{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.edit-item .ctrls button{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3);border-radius:10px;width:34px;height:30px;font-size:15px;color:#fff;font-weight:800}
.swatches{display:flex;gap:5px;grid-column:1/-1;flex-wrap:wrap}
.swatches button{width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.6)}
.swatches button.on{border-color:#fff;transform:scale(1.2);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{background:#f2eeff;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 14px;font-weight:700;border:2px solid transparent}
.chip.on{background:var(--bg1);color:#fff}
.step{display:flex;gap:12px;margin:14px 0}
.step .n{flex:0 0 34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg1);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800}
#qrbox{background:#fff;padding:10px;border-radius:16px;display:inline-block;border:3px solid #efeaff}
#qrbox img,#qrbox canvas{display:block;width:200px;height:200px}
.emoji-pick{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;margin-top:6px}
.emoji-pick button{font-size:26px;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:8px}
.emoji-pick button:active{background:#eee}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<!-- ============ WELCOME ============ -->
<section id="welcome" class="hidden">
<div class="center">
<div class="logo">📣 BuzzPal<small>Magic buttons that buzz your grown-up</small></div>
<div class="panel" style="width:100%;margin-top:24px">
<h2 style="margin-bottom:8px">👋 Hi! Who is setting up this device?</h2>
<p class="muted">Start on the <b>parent's phone</b> first. It will make a QR code for the kid's iPad.</p>
<button class="btn big" id="wParent" style="margin-bottom:12px">📱 I'm the parent</button>
<button class="btn big ghost" id="wKid">🧒 This is my kid's iPad</button>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ PARENT FIRST SETUP ============ -->
<section id="psetup" class="hidden">
<div class="center">
<div class="logo" style="font-size:44px">📱 Parent setup</div>
<form class="panel" id="psetupForm" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">
<label class="f">Your kid's name</label>
<input class="inp" id="psKid" placeholder="e.g. Leo" required maxlength="20">
<label class="f">What does your kid call you?</label>
<input class="inp" id="psParent" placeholder="e.g. Dad, Mom, Papa" required maxlength="20">
<label class="f">Secret parent PIN (4 digits)</label>
<input class="inp" id="psPin" inputmode="numeric" pattern="[0-9]{4}" maxlength="4" placeholder="Locks the button editor on the iPad" required>
<button class="btn big" style="margin-top:18px" type="submit">✨ Create our BuzzPal</button>
<button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="psBack" style="margin-top:10px;width:100%">← Back</button>
</form>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ KID JOIN ============ -->
<section id="kjoin" class="hidden">
<div class="center">
<div class="logo" style="font-size:44px">🧒 Connect iPad</div>
<form class="panel" id="kjoinForm" style="width:100%;margin-top:18px">
<p>Easiest: on the parent's phone open <b>BuzzPal → ⚙️ Setup</b> and scan the QR code with this iPad's camera.</p>
<p class="muted">Or type the family code shown there:</p>
<input class="inp" id="kjCode" placeholder="bz-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx" autocapitalize="off" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" required>
<button class="btn big" style="margin-top:14px" type="submit">🔗 Connect</button>
<button class="btn ghost" type="button" id="kjBack" style="margin-top:10px;width:100%">← Back</button>
</form>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ KID VIEW ============ -->
<section id="kid" class="hidden">
<div class="tip hidden" id="installTip">
<span style="font-size:34px">📲</span>
<div style="flex:1"><b>Grown-up tip:</b> tap the Share button <b>⬆️</b> in Safari, then <b>“Add to Home Screen”</b> to turn this into an app on the iPad.</div>
<button class="btn ghost" id="installTipX">OK</button>
</div>
<div class="kid-top">
<h1 id="kidTitle">Hi!</h1>
<div class="status" id="kidStatus"><span class="dot"></span><span>connecting…</span></div>
</div>
<div class="moods" id="moods"></div>
<div class="recharge-wrap hidden" id="rechargeWrap">⚡ Recharging…<div class="recharge"><i id="rechargeBar"></i></div></div>
<div class="grid" id="kgrid"></div>
<div class="kid-foot">
<button class="lastreply hidden" id="lastReply"></button>
<span></span>
<button class="gear" id="gear" aria-label="Parent settings (press and hold)">⚙️<span class="ring"></span></button>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ PARENT VIEW ============ -->
<section id="parent" class="hidden">
<div class="p-top">
<h1>📣 BuzzPal</h1>
<button class="btn ghost hidden" id="pClose">✕ Back to buttons</button>
</div>
<div class="tabs" id="ptabs">
<button data-tab="inbox" class="on">📬 Inbox</button>
<button data-tab="reply">💬 Reply</button>
<button data-tab="buttons">🎨 Buttons</button>
<button data-tab="setup">⚙️ Setup</button>
</div>
<div data-pane="inbox">
<div class="panel">
<div class="row" style="justify-content:space-between"><h2 id="inboxTitle">Messages</h2><span class="status small" id="pStatus" style="background:#f2eeff;color:var(--ink)"><span class="dot"></span><span>…</span></span></div>
<p class="muted small" style="margin:4px 0 0">Last 12 hours. Tap a quick reply to answer instantly.</p>
<div id="inbox"><p class="muted">No messages yet. 📭</p></div>
</div>
</div>
<div data-pane="reply" class="hidden">
<div class="panel">
<h2>💬 Quick replies</h2>
<p class="muted small">Tap one and it pops up on the iPad with an animation and a sound.</p>
<div class="rgrid" id="rgrid"></div>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h2>✏️ Make your own</h2>
<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:nowrap">
<input class="inp" id="cEmoji" style="width:72px;text-align:center;font-size:28px;padding:6px" value="🦖" maxlength="8">
<input class="inp" id="cText" placeholder="Your message…" maxlength="80">
</div>
<div class="emoji-pick" id="cEmojiPick"></div>
<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:nowrap">
<div style="flex:1"><label class="f">Animation</label><select class="inp" id="cAnim"></select></div>
<div style="flex:1"><label class="f">Sound</label><select class="inp" id="cSound"></select></div>
</div>
<div class="row" style="margin-top:14px">
<button class="btn ghost" id="cPreview">👀 Preview</button>
<button class="btn" id="cSend" style="flex:1">🚀 Send to iPad</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div data-pane="buttons" class="hidden">
<div class="panel">
<h2>🎛️ Kid's buttons</h2>
<p class="muted small">Change the emoji, words and color. Then press <b>Save</b> and the iPad updates by itself.</p>
<div id="editList"></div>
<button class="btn ghost" id="addBtn" style="width:100%">➕ Add a button</button>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h2>🎭 Mood stickers</h2>
<p class="muted small">Which moods can your kid add to a button?</p>
<div class="chips" id="moodChips"></div>
<label class="f">⏱️ Wait time between presses: <span id="cdVal"></span></label>
<input type="range" id="cooldown" min="0" max="60" step="1" style="width:100%">
<p class="muted small" style="margin:0">Stops 50 notifications in a row 😅</p>
</div>
<button class="btn big" id="saveCfg" style="margin-bottom:14px">💾 Save & send to iPad</button>
</div>
<div data-pane="setup" class="hidden">
<div class="panel" id="setupSteps">
<h2>📲 Connect everything</h2>
<div class="step"><div class="n">1</div><div>
<b>Get notifications on this phone:</b> install the free <b>ntfy</b> app
(<a href="https://apps.apple.com/app/ntfy/id1625396347" target="_blank" rel="noopener">iPhone</a> ·
<a href="https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.heckel.ntfy" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Android</a>),
tap <b>＋</b> and subscribe to this topic:
<div style="margin:6px 0"><span class="code" id="kidTopic"></span></div>
<button class="btn ghost" data-copy="kidTopic">📋 Copy topic</button>
<p class="muted small" style="margin:6px 0 0">Server stays the default <b>ntfy.sh</b>. Allow notifications when asked.</p>
</div></div>
<div class="step"><div class="n">2</div><div>
<b>On your kid's iPad:</b> open the Camera and scan this code, or open the link in Safari:
<div style="margin:8px 0"><div id="qrbox"></div></div>
<div><span class="code small" id="kidLink"></span></div>
<button class="btn ghost" data-copy="kidLink" style="margin-top:6px">📋 Copy link</button>
</div></div>
<div class="step"><div class="n">3</div><div>
In Safari on the iPad tap <b>Share ⬆️ → Add to Home Screen</b>. Now it's an app! 🎉
</div></div>
<div class="step"><div class="n">4</div><div>
Add <b>this</b> page to your own home screen too, so you can reply with animations and edit buttons.
Your parent link: <span class="code small" id="parentLink"></span>
<button class="btn ghost" data-copy="parentLink" style="margin-top:6px">📋 Copy</button>
</div></div>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h2>👪 Names & PIN</h2>
<label class="f">Kid's name</label><input class="inp" id="sKid" maxlength="20">
<label class="f">Your name (as your kid calls you)</label><input class="inp" id="sParent" maxlength="20">
<label class="f">Parent PIN (unlocks editing on the iPad)</label><input class="inp" id="sPin" inputmode="numeric" maxlength="4">
<button class="btn" id="saveNames" style="margin-top:14px;width:100%">💾 Save & send to iPad</button>
</div>
<div class="panel">
<h2>🔐 Family code</h2>
<p class="small">Your private code: <span class="code" id="famCode"></span></p>
<p class="muted small">Anyone with this code could see and send messages, so keep it secret. If it leaks, make a new one and connect both devices again.</p>
<div class="row">
<button class="btn ghost" id="testNotif">🔔 Send test notification</button>
<button class="btn danger" id="resetAll">♻️ Reset this device</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
<!-- ============ OVERLAYS ============ -->
<div class="ov hidden" id="pinOv">
<div class="sheet" style="text-align:center">
<h2>🔒 Grown-ups only</h2>
<p class="muted" style="margin:4px 0 0">Enter the parent PIN</p>
<div class="pindots" id="pindots"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
<div class="pinpad" id="pinpad"></div>
<button class="btn ghost" id="pinCancel" style="margin-top:12px;width:100%">Cancel</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ov hidden" id="reveal">
<div class="card" id="revealCard">
<div class="from" id="rvFrom"></div>
<div class="bigE" id="rvE"></div>
<div class="msg" id="rvMsg"></div>
<div class="tapsound hidden" id="rvTap">🔊 Tap to hear it!</div>
<button class="btn big" id="rvOk">Yay! 👍</button>
</div>
</div>
<div class="ov hidden" id="confirmOv">
<div class="sheet">
<h2 id="cfTitle"></h2>
<p id="cfText" class="muted"></p>
<div class="row" style="justify-content:flex-end">
<button class="btn ghost" id="cfNo">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn danger" id="cfYes">Yes</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>
<script>
'use strict';
/* =========================================================
BuzzPal — kid buttons → parent's phone (via ntfy.sh)
Topics (all derived from one secret family code):
<code>-kid kid → parent (parent's ntfy app subscribes)
<code>-reply parent → kid (animated replies)
<code>-config parent → kid (button layout, names, PIN)
========================================================= */
const NTFY = 'https://ntfy.sh';
const $ = s => document.querySelector(s);
const $$ = s => [...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const LS = {
get(k, d){ try{ const v = localStorage.getItem('buzzpal_'+k); return v == null ? d : JSON.parse(v); }catch(e){ return d; } },
set(k, v){ try{ localStorage.setItem('buzzpal_'+k, JSON.stringify(v)); }catch(e){} },
clear(){ try{ Object.keys(localStorage).filter(k=>k.startsWith('buzzpal_')).forEach(k=>localStorage.removeItem(k)); }catch(e){} }
};
const esc = s => String(s ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
const clone = o => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o));
const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
/* ---------------- data ---------------- */
const COLORS = ['#ff7a59','#f59e0b','#22c55e','#14b8a6','#2bb3ff','#6366f1','#7c5cff','#ff5fa2','#ef4444','#a16207'];
const DEFAULT_BUTTONS = [
{e:'🍕', t:"I'm hungry", c:'#ff7a59'},
{e:'🎮', t:'Can I play games?', c:'#7c5cff'},
{e:'📺', t:'Can I watch TV?', c:'#2bb3ff'},
{e:'📞', t:'Please call me', c:'#22c55e'},
{e:'🤗', t:'I miss you', c:'#ff5fa2'},
{e:'🏠', t:'When are you coming home?', c:'#f59e0b'},
{e:'😴', t:"I'm bored", c:'#6366f1'},
{e:'❤️', t:'I love you!', c:'#ef4444'},
];
const MOODS = {
normal: {e:'😊', n:'Happy', tags:[], prio:3},
angry: {e:'😡', n:'Angry', tags:['rage'], prio:4, fx:t => t.toUpperCase().replace(/[.!?]*$/,'') + '!!! 😤'},
sad: {e:'😢', n:'Sad', tags:['cry'], prio:3, fx:t => t.replace(/[.!]*$/,'') + '… 🥺💧'},
urgent: {e:'🚨', n:'Urgent', tags:['rotating_light'], prio:5, fx:t => '‼️ ' + t.toUpperCase() + ' ‼️'},
silly: {e:'🤪', n:'Silly', tags:['zany_face'], prio:3, fx:t => sillify(t)},
question: {e:'❓', n:'Question', tags:['question'], prio:3, fx:t => t.replace(/[.!?]*$/,'') + '???'},
};
const MOOD_ORDER = ['angry','sad','urgent','silly','question'];
const SILLY_ENDS = ['…said the banana 🍌','*fart noise* 💨','beep boop 🤖','🦄🦄🦄','with extra cheese 🧀','…and also I am a dinosaur 🦖','wiggle wiggle 🐛','🐸 ribbit!','…in a pirate voice 🏴‍☠️','🥔 potato!'];
function sillify(t){
let i = 0;
const wavy = [...t].map(ch => /[a-z]/i.test(ch) ? ((i++ % 2) ? ch.toUpperCase() : ch.toLowerCase()) : ch).join('');
return wavy + ' ' + SILLY_ENDS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SILLY_ENDS.length)];
}
const ANIMS = {
pop:'💥 Pop', confetti:'🎊 Confetti', hearts:'💕 Heart rain', stars:'🌟 Star shower', shake:'🫨 Shake', wobble:'〰️ Wobble',
spin:'🌀 Spin', bounce:'🏀 Bounce', zoom:'🏎️ Zoom in', ring:'📳 Ringing', zzz:'💤 Sleepy', rainbow:'🌈 Rainbow', balloons:'🎈 Balloons'
};
const SOUNDS = {
ding:'🔔 Ding', chime:'🎐 Chime', fanfare:'🎺 Ta-da!', bonk:'🔨 Bonk', boing:'🦘 Boing', hmm:'🤔 Hmmm', tick:'⏰ Tick-tock',
ring:'☎️ Ring ring', whoosh:'💨 Whoosh', sparkle:'✨ Sparkle', lullaby:'🌙 Lullaby', pfft:'💨 Toot', kiss:'😘 Mwah', none:'🔇 No sound'
};
const REPLIES = {
yes: {e:'👍', t:'Yes!', a:'confetti', s:'fanfare', c:'#22c55e'},
no: {e:'🙅', t:'Not right now', a:'shake', s:'bonk', c:'#ef4444'},
maybe: {e:'🤔', t:'Maybe… let me think', a:'wobble', s:'hmm', c:'#f59e0b'},
ok: {e:'👌', t:'Got it!', a:'pop', s:'ding', c:'#14b8a6'},
love: {e:'❤️', t:'Love you too!', a:'hearts', s:'kiss', c:'#ff5fa2'},
wait: {e:'⏳', t:'Give me a few minutes', a:'spin', s:'tick', c:'#6366f1'},
call: {e:'📞', t:"I'll call you soon!", a:'ring', s:'ring', c:'#2bb3ff'},
omw: {e:'🏃', t:"I'm on my way!", a:'zoom', s:'whoosh', c:'#f59e0b'},
haha: {e:'🤣', t:'Hahaha!', a:'bounce', s:'boing', c:'#7c5cff'},
proud: {e:'🌟', t:"I'm proud of you!", a:'stars', s:'sparkle', c:'#a16207'},
hug: {e:'🤗', t:'Big hug!', a:'hearts', s:'chime', c:'#ff7a59'},
bed: {e:'😴', t:'Time for bed!', a:'zzz', s:'lullaby', c:'#4338ca'},
party: {e:'🥳', t:'Woohoo!', a:'balloons', s:'fanfare', c:'#ec4899'},
silly: {e:'🤪', t:'You silly goose!', a:'rainbow', s:'pfft', c:'#10b981'},
};
const PICK_EMOJI = ['🦖','🐶','🍦','🎉','🚀','🍕','⚽','🎮','🦄','🐱','🌈','👻','🤖','🍪','🐸','💪','😎','🥰','🙈','⭐'];
/* ---------------- state ---------------- */
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
let family = cleanCode(params.get('family')) || LS.get('family', null);
let role = params.get('role') || LS.get('role', null);
if (cleanCode(params.get('family'))) LS.set('family', family);
if (params.get('role')) LS.set('role', role);
let cfg = Object.assign({
v:1, kidName:'', parentName:'', pin:'1234', cooldown:8,
moods: MOOD_ORDER.slice(), buttons: clone(DEFAULT_BUTTONS), updated:0
}, LS.get('cfg', {}));
let curMood = 'normal';
let cooldownUntil = 0;
let audioReady = false;
let es = null;
function cleanCode(c){ if(!c) return null; c = String(c).trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g,''); return c.length >= 10 ? c : null; }
function newCode(){
const abc = 'abcdefghjkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789';
const r = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(12));
const s = [...r].map(b => abc[b % abc.length]).join('');
return `bz-${s.slice(0,4)}-${s.slice(4,8)}-${s.slice(8,12)}`;
}
const T = {
kid: () => family + '-kid',
reply: () => family + '-reply',
config: () => family + '-config',
};
function appUrl(r){
const u = new URL(location.href);
u.search = ''; u.hash = '';
u.searchParams.set('family', family); u.searchParams.set('role', r);
return u.toString();
}
function saveCfg(){ LS.set('cfg', cfg); }
/* ---------------- toast / confirm ---------------- */
let toastTimer;
function toast(msg, ms=2200){
const t = $('#toast'); t.textContent = msg; t.classList.add('show');
clearTimeout(toastTimer); toastTimer = setTimeout(() => t.classList.remove('show'), ms);
}
function confirmBox(title, text){
return new Promise(res => {
$('#cfTitle').textContent = title; $('#cfText').textContent = text;
$('#confirmOv').classList.remove('hidden');
const done = v => { $('#confirmOv').classList.add('hidden'); $('#cfYes').onclick = $('#cfNo').onclick = null; res(v); };
$('#cfYes').onclick = () => done(true); $('#cfNo').onclick = () => done(false);
});
}
/* ---------------- sound (Web Audio, no files needed) ---------------- */
let ac = null;
function audio(){
if (!ac){ try{ ac = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); }catch(e){ return null; } }
if (ac.state === 'suspended') ac.resume();
return ac;
}
function unlockAudio(){
const a = audio(); if (!a) return;
// play a silent blip so iOS fully unlocks the audio
const o = a.createOscillator(), g = a.createGain(); g.gain.value = 0.0001;
o.connect(g).connect(a.destination); o.start(); o.stop(a.currentTime + 0.02);
audioReady = true;
}
document.addEventListener('pointerdown', unlockAudio, {passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchend', unlockAudio, {passive:true});
function tone(freq, start, dur, {type='sine', vol=0.25, to=null, attack=0.01} = {}){
const a = audio(); if (!a) return;
const t0 = a.currentTime + start;
const o = a.createOscillator(), g = a.createGain();
o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, t0);
if (to) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(to, t0 + dur);
g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + attack);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
o.connect(g).connect(a.destination); o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.05);
}
function noise(start, dur, {from=400, to=4000, vol=0.3} = {}){
const a = audio(); if (!a) return;
const t0 = a.currentTime + start;
const buf = a.createBuffer(1, a.sampleRate * dur, a.sampleRate);
const d = buf.getChannelData(0); for (let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i] = Math.random()*2-1;
const src = a.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = buf;
const f = a.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = 'bandpass'; f.Q.value = 1.2;
f.frequency.setValueAtTime(from, t0); f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(to, t0 + dur);
const g = a.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t0);
g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol, t0 + dur*0.4); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t0 + dur);
src.connect(f).connect(g).connect(a.destination); src.start(t0);
}
const N = n => 440 * Math.pow(2, (n - 69) / 12); // midi → Hz
function playSound(name){
switch(name){
case 'ding': tone(N(88),0,1.2,{vol:.3}); tone(N(100),0,.8,{vol:.08}); break;
case 'chime': [72,76,79,84].forEach((n,i)=>tone(N(n),i*.12,1.1,{vol:.22})); break;
case 'fanfare': [[67,0,.15],[72,.15,.15],[76,.3,.15],[79,.45,.5],[76,.75,.15],[79,.9,.7]].forEach(([n,s,d])=>{tone(N(n),s,d,{type:'square',vol:.09});tone(N(n-12),s,d,{type:'triangle',vol:.15});}); break;
case 'bonk': tone(220,0,.35,{type:'triangle',to:60,vol:.5}); noise(0,.08,{from:800,to:300,vol:.3}); break;
case 'boing': tone(150,0,.6,{to:600,vol:.3}); tone(600,.3,.5,{to:200,vol:.2}); break;
case 'hmm': tone(N(60),0,.5,{type:'triangle',vol:.25}); tone(N(57),.45,.6,{type:'triangle',vol:.25}); tone(N(62),1.0,.7,{type:'triangle',vol:.22}); break;
case 'tick': for(let i=0;i<6;i++) tone(i%2?1800:1400,i*.3,.05,{type:'square',vol:.12}); tone(N(84),1.9,.8,{vol:.25}); break;
case 'ring': for(let i=0;i<14;i++) tone(i%2?1300:1600,i*.05,.05,{type:'square',vol:.07}); for(let i=0;i<14;i++) tone(i%2?1300:1600,.9+i*.05,.05,{type:'square',vol:.07}); break;
case 'whoosh': noise(0,.7,{from:300,to:5000,vol:.35}); break;
case 'sparkle': for(let i=0;i<10;i++) tone(N(84+Math.floor(Math.random()*14)),i*.07,.4,{vol:.12}); break;
case 'lullaby': [[76,0],[74,.5],[72,1],[74,1.5],[76,2],[76,2.4],[76,2.8]].forEach(([n,s])=>tone(N(n),s,.6,{type:'triangle',vol:.2,attack:.05})); break;
case 'pfft': { const a = audio(); if(!a) break; const t0=a.currentTime; const o=a.createOscillator(), l=a.createOscillator(), lg=a.createGain(), g=a.createGain();
o.type='sawtooth'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(110,t0); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(60,t0+.7);
l.frequency.value=28; lg.gain.value=40; l.connect(lg).connect(o.frequency);
g.gain.setValueAtTime(.0001,t0); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.3,t0+.03); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t0+.75);
o.connect(g).connect(a.destination); o.start(t0); l.start(t0); o.stop(t0+.8); l.stop(t0+.8); } break;
case 'kiss': tone(900,0,.12,{to:2200,vol:.25}); noise(.05,.08,{from:3000,to:6000,vol:.15}); tone(N(79),.3,.5,{vol:.15}); tone(N(84),.45,.6,{vol:.15}); break;
case 'send': tone(N(72),0,.12,{vol:.2}); tone(N(79),.08,.2,{vol:.2}); noise(.05,.35,{from:500,to:4000,vol:.12}); break;
case 'error': tone(N(55),0,.25,{type:'square',vol:.08}); tone(N(50),.2,.35,{type:'square',vol:.08}); break;
}
}
/* ---------------- animations ---------------- */
function rain(chars, n=36, {confetti=false} = {}){
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
const p = document.createElement('div');
p.className = 'particle' + (confetti ? ' confetto' : '');
if (confetti) p.style.background = COLORS[i % COLORS.length];
else { p.textContent = chars[i % chars.length]; p.style.fontSize = (28 + Math.random()*34) + 'px'; }
p.style.left = (Math.random()*100) + 'vw';
p.style.animationDuration = (2.2 + Math.random()*2.2) + 's';
p.style.animationDelay = (Math.random()*1.4) + 's';
p.style.setProperty('--rot', (Math.random()*720-360) + 'deg');
document.body.appendChild(p);
setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 6000);
}
}
function rise(chars, n=18){
for (let i=0;i<n;i++){
const p = document.createElement('div');
p.className = 'particle';
p.textContent = chars[i % chars.length];
p.style.fontSize = (34 + Math.random()*30) + 'px';
p.style.left = (Math.random()*100) + 'vw';
p.style.top = '110vh';
p.style.animation = `none`;
p.animate([{transform:'translateY(0)'},{transform:`translateY(-130vh) translateX(${Math.random()*80-40}px)`}],
{duration: 3000 + Math.random()*2500, delay: Math.random()*1200, easing:'ease-out', fill:'forwards'});
document.body.appendChild(p);
setTimeout(() => p.remove(), 7000);
}
}
function runAnim(el, a){
el.className = 'bigE';
void el.offsetWidth; // restart animation
const cls = {pop:'a-pop', shake:'a-shake', wobble:'a-wobble', spin:'a-spin', bounce:'a-bounce', zoom:'a-zoom', ring:'a-ring',
zzz:'a-float', hearts:'a-pulse', stars:'a-pop', confetti:'a-pop', rainbow:'a-bounce', balloons:'a-float'}[a] || 'a-pop';
el.classList.add(cls);
$('#revealCard').classList.toggle('rainbow-bg', a === 'rainbow');
if (a === 'confetti') rain([], 70, {confetti:true});
if (a === 'hearts') rain(['❤️','💖','💕','💗','😘'], 40);
if (a === 'stars') rain(['⭐','🌟','✨','💫'], 40);
if (a === 'zzz') rise(['💤','🌙','⭐'], 16);
if (a === 'balloons') rise(['🎈','🎈','🎉','🎈'], 22);
if (a === 'rainbow') rain(['🌈','🦄','✨'], 24);
if (a === 'shake' && navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([100,50,100]);
}
/* ---------------- reply reveal (kid side, also used for parent preview) ---------------- */
let revealQueue = [], revealing = false, pendingSound = null;
function showReveal(r, from){
revealQueue.push({r, from});
if (!revealing) nextReveal();
}
function nextReveal(){
const item = revealQueue.shift();
if (!item){ revealing = false; $('#reveal').classList.add('hidden'); return; }
revealing = true;
const {r, from} = item;
$('#rvFrom').textContent = from;
$('#rvE').textContent = r.e || '💬';
$('#rvMsg').textContent = r.t || '';
$('#reveal').classList.remove('hidden');
runAnim($('#rvE'), r.a);
if (r.s && r.s !== 'none'){
if (audioReady && ac && ac.state === 'running'){ playSound(r.s); $('#rvTap').classList.add('hidden'); pendingSound = null; }
else { pendingSound = r.s; $('#rvTap').classList.remove('hidden'); }
} else $('#rvTap').classList.add('hidden');
}
$('#revealCard').addEventListener('click', e => {
if (pendingSound && e.target.id !== 'rvOk'){ unlockAudio(); playSound(pendingSound); pendingSound = null; $('#rvTap').classList.add('hidden'); }
});
$('#rvOk').addEventListener('click', () => {
if (pendingSound){ unlockAudio(); playSound(pendingSound); pendingSound = null; }
nextReveal();
});
/* ---------------- ntfy helpers ---------------- */
async function publish(body){
const res = await fetch(NTFY + '/', { method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify(body) });
if (!res.ok) throw new Error('ntfy ' + res.status);
return res.json().catch(() => ({}));
}
function subscribe(topics, since, onMsg, onState){
if (es) { es.close(); es = null; }
const url = `${NTFY}/${topics.join(',')}/sse?since=${encodeURIComponent(since)}`;
try { es = new EventSource(url); } catch(e){ onState('off'); return; }
onState('wait');
es.onopen = () => onState('on');
es.onerror = () => onState(es && es.readyState === 2 ? 'off' : 'wait');
es.onmessage = ev => {
let m; try { m = JSON.parse(ev.data); } catch(e){ return; }
if (m.event !== 'message') return;
onMsg(m);
};
}
function setStatus(el, state, labels){
el.classList.remove('on','off');
if (state === 'on') el.classList.add('on');
if (state === 'off') el.classList.add('off');
el.querySelector('span:last-child').textContent = labels[state];
}
/* =========================================================
KID MODE
========================================================= */
function renderKid(){
$('#kidTitle').textContent = cfg.kidName ? `Hi ${cfg.kidName}! 👋` : 'Hi! 👋';
// moods
const enabled = ['normal', ...MOOD_ORDER.filter(m => cfg.moods.includes(m))];
if (!enabled.includes(curMood)) curMood = 'normal';
$('#moods').innerHTML = enabled.length > 1 ? enabled.map(k =>
`<button class="mood ${k===curMood?'sel':''}" data-mood="${k}"><span class="me">${MOODS[k].e}</span>${MOODS[k].n}</button>`).join('') : '';
// buttons
$('#kgrid').innerHTML = cfg.buttons.map((b,i) =>
`<button class="kbtn" data-i="${i}" style="background:${esc(b.c)}"><span class="e">${esc(b.e)}</span><span class="t">${esc(b.t)}</span></button>`).join('');
updateCooldownUI();
}
$('#moods').addEventListener('click', e => {
const b = e.target.closest('.mood'); if (!b) return;
curMood = (curMood === b.dataset.mood && b.dataset.mood !== 'normal') ? 'normal' : b.dataset.mood;
playSound({normal:'ding', angry:'bonk', sad:'hmm', urgent:'ring', silly:'pfft', question:'boing'}[curMood]);
renderKid();
});
$('#kgrid').addEventListener('click', async e => {
const el = e.target.closest('.kbtn'); if (!el) return;
if (Date.now() < cooldownUntil){ playSound('error'); el.classList.add('shake'); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('shake'),500); return; }
const b = cfg.buttons[+el.dataset.i];
const mood = MOODS[curMood];
const text = mood.fx ? mood.fx(b.t) : b.t;
const isQ = curMood === 'question' || /\?\s*$/.test(b.t);
const replyUrl = `${NTFY}/${T.reply()}`;
const act = (key) => ({ action:'http', label:`${REPLIES[key].e} ${REPLIES[key].t}`.slice(0,24), url:replyUrl, method:'POST',
body: JSON.stringify({k:'reply', id:key}), clear:true });
const msg = {
topic: T.kid(),
title: `${cfg.kidName || 'Your kid'}: ${b.e} ${curMood !== 'normal' ? '(' + mood.n.toLowerCase() + ')' : ''}`.trim(),
message: text,
tags: mood.tags,
priority: mood.prio,
click: appUrl('parent'),
actions: isQ ? [act('yes'), act('no'), act('maybe')] : [act('ok'), act('love'), act('wait')]
};
el.classList.remove('sent'); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('sent');
playSound('send');
try {
await publish(msg);
flyAway(el, b.e);
toast(`✅ Sent to ${cfg.parentName || 'your grown-up'}!`);
cooldownUntil = Date.now() + (cfg.cooldown || 0) * 1000;
if (curMood !== 'normal'){ curMood = 'normal'; renderKid(); }
updateCooldownUI();
} catch(err){
playSound('error'); el.classList.add('shake'); setTimeout(()=>el.classList.remove('shake'),500);
toast('😬 Oops, it didn\'t send. Is the wifi on? Try again!', 3500);
}
});
function flyAway(el, emoji){
const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
const f = document.createElement('div'); f.className = 'flyer'; f.textContent = '🚀';
f.style.left = (r.left + r.width/2 - 35) + 'px'; f.style.top = (r.top + r.height/2 - 35) + 'px';
document.body.appendChild(f); setTimeout(() => f.remove(), 1200);
}
let cdTimer = null;
function updateCooldownUI(){
const left = cooldownUntil - Date.now();
const total = (cfg.cooldown || 0) * 1000;
const on = left > 0 && total > 0;
$('#rechargeWrap').classList.toggle('hidden', !on);
$$('.kbtn').forEach(b => b.toggleAttribute('disabled', on));
if (on){
$('#rechargeBar').style.width = (100 - left/total*100) + '%';
clearTimeout(cdTimer); cdTimer = setTimeout(updateCooldownUI, 100);
}
}
function kidIncoming(m){
const seen = LS.get('seen', []);
if (seen.includes(m.id)) return;
LS.set('seen', [m.id, ...seen].slice(0, 40));
LS.set('since', m.time);
let p; try { p = JSON.parse(m.message); } catch(e){ return; }
if (m.topic === T.config() && p.k === 'config' && p.cfg){
if ((p.cfg.updated || 0) > (cfg.updated || 0)){
cfg = Object.assign(cfg, p.cfg); saveCfg(); renderKid();
if (Date.now()/1000 - m.time < 60) toast('✨ New buttons arrived!');
}
}
if (m.topic === T.reply() && p.k === 'reply'){
const r = p.id && REPLIES[p.id] ? REPLIES[p.id] : {e:p.e, t:p.t, a:p.a, s:p.s};
LS.set('lastReply', r);
showLastReply();
// replies that arrived while the app was closed: only show if fairly fresh
if (Date.now()/1000 - m.time < 3*3600) showReveal(r, `💌 From ${cfg.parentName || 'your grown-up'}`);
}
}
function showLastReply(){
const r = LS.get('lastReply', null);
const el = $('#lastReply');
if (!r){ el.classList.add('hidden'); return; }
el.classList.remove('hidden'); el.textContent = `Last answer: ${r.e} ${r.t}`;
el.onclick = () => showReveal(r, `💌 From ${cfg.parentName || 'your grown-up'}`);
}
function startKid(){
editingOnKid = false;
show('kid');
renderKid(); showLastReply();
const standalone = navigator.standalone || matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)').matches;
if (!standalone && !LS.get('tipDone', false)) $('#installTip').classList.remove('hidden');
connectKid();
}
function connectKid(){
const since = LS.get('since', null) || '12h';
subscribe([T.reply(), T.config()], since, kidIncoming, st =>
setStatus($('#kidStatus'), st, {on:`connected to ${cfg.parentName || 'grown-up'}`, wait:'connecting…', off:'no wifi?'}));
}
$('#installTipX').onclick = () => { LS.set('tipDone', true); $('#installTip').classList.add('hidden'); };
/* secret gear: press & hold → PIN → editor */
let holdT = null;
const gear = $('#gear');
const startHold = e => { e.preventDefault(); gear.classList.add('holding'); holdT = setTimeout(() => { gear.classList.remove('holding'); openPin(); }, 1600); };
const endHold = () => { clearTimeout(holdT); gear.classList.remove('holding'); };
gear.addEventListener('pointerdown', startHold);
['pointerup','pointerleave','pointercancel'].forEach(ev => gear.addEventListener(ev, endHold));
gear.addEventListener('contextmenu', e => e.preventDefault());
let pinBuf = '';
function openPin(){
pinBuf = ''; drawPin();
$('#pinOv').classList.remove('hidden');
}
function drawPin(){ $$('#pindots i').forEach((d,i) => d.classList.toggle('f', i < pinBuf.length)); }
$('#pinpad').innerHTML = [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,'',0,'⌫'].map(k => k === '' ? '<span></span>' : `<button data-k="${k}">${k}</button>`).join('');
$('#pinpad').addEventListener('click', e => {
const k = e.target.dataset.k; if (k == null) return;
if (k === '⌫') pinBuf = pinBuf.slice(0,-1); else if (pinBuf.length < 4) pinBuf += k;
drawPin();
if (pinBuf.length === 4){

else { playSound('error'); const s = $('#pinOv .sheet'); s.classList.add('shake'); setTimeout(()=>{s.classList.remove('shake'); pinBuf=''; drawPin();},450); }
}
});

PARENT MODE (parent's phone, or unlocked on the iPad)

function openParent(onKid){

show('parent');

draft = clone(cfg);
renderEditor(); renderSetup(); renderReplies();
tab(onKid ? 'buttons' : (LS.get('ptab', 'inbox')));

function tab(name){
$$('#ptabs button').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('on', b.dataset.tab === name));
$$('[data-pane]').forEach(p => p.classList.toggle('hidden', p.dataset.pane !== name));

if (name === 'setup') drawQR();

/* ---- inbox ---- */

if (inbox.some(x => x.id === m.id)) return;
inbox.unshift(m); inbox.sort((a,b) => b.time - a.time);

function renderInbox(){

</div></div>`;
}).join('');

async function commitDraft(){
draft.buttons = draft.buttons.map(b => ({e:(b.e||'⭐').trim(), t:(b.t||'').trim() || 'Button', c:b.c}));
draft.updated = Date.now();
cfg = clone(draft); saveCfg();
const ok = await pushConfig();
if (editingOnKid){ toast('💾 Saved!'); startKid(); }
else toast(ok ? '✨ Saved! The iPad will update in a moment.' : '💾 Saved here, but could not reach the iPad right now.', 3000);
}
async function pushConfig(){
try { await publish({ topic: T.config(), message: JSON.stringify({k:'config', cfg}) }); LS.set('cfgPushed', Date.now()); return true; }
catch(e){ return false; }
}
/* ---- setup ---- */
function renderSetup(){
$('#kidTopic').textContent = T.kid();
$('#kidLink').textContent = appUrl('kid');

$('#famCode').textContent = family;

$('#setupSteps').classList.toggle('hidden', editingOnKid);

let qrDone = false;
function drawQR(){
if (qrDone || editingOnKid) return;
const box = $('#qrbox');
if (window.QRCode){ box.innerHTML = ''; new QRCode(box, {text: appUrl('kid'), width:400, height:400, correctLevel: QRCode.CorrectLevel.M}); qrDone = true; }
else { box.innerHTML = '<p class="muted small" style="width:200px">QR code could not load — use the link below instead.</p>'; setTimeout(drawQR, 1500); }
}
$('#saveNames').onclick = () => {
const pin = $('#sPin').value.trim();
if (!/^\d{4}$/.test(pin)) return toast('PIN must be 4 digits');
draft.kidName = $('#sKid').value.trim(); draft.parentName = $('#sParent').value.trim(); draft.pin = pin;
commitDraft();
};
$$('[data-copy]').forEach(b => b.onclick = async () => {
const txt = $('#' + b.dataset.copy).textContent;
try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt); toast('📋 Copied!'); }
catch(e){ toast('Press and hold the text to copy it'); }
});
$('#testNotif').onclick = async () => {
try {
await publish({topic:T.kid(), title:`${cfg.kidName || 'Your kid'}: 🧪`, message:'This is a test! If you see this, BuzzPal works 🎉', tags:['tada'], click:appUrl('parent')});
toast('🔔 Sent! Check your notifications.');
} catch(e){ toast('😬 Could not reach ntfy.sh'); }
};
